messages:
kelly (AE): StarterFold sent an RFI asking for a capability matrix + detailed answers on egress charges, BYOK/KMS, and POC pricing. They want a draft back by EOD Thu. Can @tanvi and ops weigh in?

tanvi (SE): on it. quick Qs — are they asking for per-token egress or network egress (GB)? they mentioned 'egress billing' but ambiguous. also need to confirm model variants we can commit to for the POC.

kelly (AE): their security contact specifically called out: (1) will we encrypt model payloads in transit and at rest w/ customer keys? (2) any hard egress caps? (3) pricing for a 2-week POC at 200 qps peak.

rachel (solutions): drafting a POC playbook now. Proposed plan: 1) 2-week dedicated sandbox on Dedicated pool (pinned model v1.2.0-quant), 2) sample traffic + perf test day, 3) monitoring + regression evals. For POC pricing I can propose a flat weekly reserve + overage per-GB.

rachel (solutions): attach: capability_matrix_starterfold_v1.xlsx (internal link) and poc_playbook_starterfold.md — both include per-feature mapping vs competitor.

sec-bot: automated note: security questionnaire (StarterFold) received — baseline SC table needs answers for KMS/HSM, data residency, SOC2/ISO, and egress controls. Please add remediation notes where required.

tanvi (SE): answers (short):
- Transit/At-rest: yes — TLS1.3 in transit; at-rest keys in KMS. For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK/HSM) and cloud KMS integrations.
- Egress billing: platform bills network egress by GB for Hosted; for Dedicated we can do an internal cross-charge or include in committed capacity. Recommend we propose two options in RFI: (A) include egress in reserved weekly price up to X GB, (B) pass-through at $0.12/GB.
- Model variants: can commit to 'redwood/gpt-medium-quant' and 'redwood/gpt-medium-fp16' for the POC; fallback policy to fp16 if quant path regresses.

kelly (AE): perfect. can you add a short blurb for the RFI about fallback policies? they want assurances for graceful degradation.

tanvi (SE): added: "Automatic fallback routing will route requests to compatible model variants and/or region-tiered capacity if SLOs are at risk; failover is observable in Console and can be opted-out per route."

rachel (solutions): POC commercial suggestion:
- Option 1 (simple): 2-week reserved throughput: $12k (includes up to 5TB egress) + optional overage $0.10/GB.
- Option 2 (flex): 2-week reserved base $7k + metered compute + egress at $0.12/GB.
Notes: pricing assumes dedicated pool and model pinning. Discounts available for multi-region replication.

kelly (AE): Dave — can you sanity-check numbers vs standard POC SKU before I send? Also need a short capability matrix summary paragraph for legal.

dave (sales-ops): numbers look fine but reduce flat price to $11k for StarterFold (mid-market discount) and include a 1-week extension option at 50% prorated. Cap the included egress at 4TB not 5TB.

kelly (AE): thanks. I'll draft the RFI answers. Plan to send a first pass in ~2 hours.

tanvi (SE): one more technical note for RFI: BYOK flow for Private: we support customer key import + automated key rotation policy. For Hosted: we recommend using customer-managed keys in their cloud KMS via key-arn binding; timeline for setup usually <= 3 business days with infra team assistance.

rachel (solutions): added a row in the capability matrix that maps "BYOK setup time" = "~3 business days (Hosted), same-day for Dedicated if keys pre-provisioned".

sec-bot: reminder: attach completed parts of the security questionnaire under the thread when ready. Also mark sensitive fields and redact sample customer IPs.

kelly (AE): will do. final ask: can someone run a quick perf estimate for 200 qps on the pinned quant model so I can include latency SLO numbers in the RFI?

tanvi (SE): estimate posted: 200 qps with 128-token context on 8xA100 pool = p50 ~ 70ms, p95 ~ 220ms, with 10% headroom recommended. I'll add a config snippet they can try:
```
route: /starterfold/api/generate
model: redwood/gpt-medium-quant
pool: dedicated-8xA100
autoscale: disabled (pinned)
cache: prefix_kv: enabled
```

kelly (AE): outstanding — thanks team. I'll assemble the RFI payload, include the capability_matrix_starterfold_v1.xlsx link and the POC pricing options. Will post back when it's sent. :rocket:

rachel (solutions): ping if you want a 1:1 walkthrough with the customer next week.

dave (sales-ops): noted discount + extension in CRM. Marking task DONE for pricing review.

kelly (AE): Thread closed once RFI sent.
